integrity.computational_support: Standalone pure-Python exact-rational Bellman verifier over 144 part-size pairs and 7524 transient count states.
integrity.main_claim: Exact three-class absorption probabilities, generating functions for entrance times, and the universally sharp expected entrance time \(79/27\) at \(K_{2,6}\) with ties in both parts.
integrity.proof_basis: Two-step sign reduction, exact first-step recurrences, exact-rational comparisons and a monotone central-binomial upper envelope.

scientific_limitations: Only synchronous, independently fair-tied binary neighbor-majority dynamics on finite loopless complete bipartite graphs is analyzed.
The bound concerns entrance into any recurrent class, including a non-consensus two-cycle, not time to unanimous agreement.
Finite computational checks corroborate but do not independently certify the all-size proof.
The literature comparison cannot establish absolute priority or rule out unindexed equivalent arguments.
title: Exact random-majority absorption laws and the sharp universal time bound on complete bipartite networks
